Soft Sleeve
US terms.
Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
Abbreviations: sc = single crochet, inc = 2 sc in the same st, dec = sc2tog.
Round 1: Work 6 sc into a magic ring. (6)
Round 2: [Inc] 6 times. (12)
Round 3: [Sc, inc] around. (18)
Round 4: Sc in next 2 sts, inc, [sc in next 2 sts, inc] 5 times, sc in next st. (24)
Work the next round in BLO.
Round 5: Sc in each st around. (24)
Rounds 6-8: Sc in each st around. (24)
Rounds 9-10: Sc in each st around. (26)
Stuff lightly and FO.

header: Title: Sunny Acorn | worked in joined rounds
text:
Sunny Acorn
US crochet terms used throughout. Each round is worked in joined rounds: join with a sl st to the first st.
Rnd 1: Work 6 sc into a magic ring, join — 6.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, [sc2inc] 6 times, join — 12.
Rnd 3: Ch 1, sc in next st, [sc in next st, sc2inc] 6 times, join — 18.
Rnd 4: Ch 1, sc in next st, [sc in next 3 sts, sc2inc] around, join — 24.
Rnd 5: Ch 1, sc in next st, sc2inc, [sc in next 3 sts, sc2inc] 5 times, sc in next 2 sts, join — 30.
Rnd 6: Ch 1, sc in next st, [sc in next 4 sts, sc2inc] around, join — 36.
Rnd 7: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sts, sc2inc] 6 times, join — 42.
Rnds 8-12: Ch 1, sc in next st, sc in next 42 sts, join — 42.
Place safety eyes between Rnd 8 and 9, about 6 sts apart.
Rnd 13: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 6 times, join — 36.
Rnd 14: Ch 1, sc in next st, [sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] around, join — 30.
Rnd 15: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times, join — 24.
Rnd 16: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times, join — 18.
Rnd 17: Ch 1, [sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times, join — 12.
Rnd 18: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 6 times, join — 6.
Fasten off, weave the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

header: Title: Plain Sleeve | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Plain Sleeve
Written in US terms.
Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
Round 1: Work 8 sc into a magic ring. (8)
Round 2: [2 sc in next st] 8 times. (16)
Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] around.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 st, 2 sc in next st] around. (32)
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times. (40)
Work the next round in BLO.
Rounds 6-10: Sc in each st around. (40)
Round 11: Sc in each st around. (40)
Rounds 12-13: Sc in next 40 st. (40)
FO, leave a long tail for sewing.

header: Title: Pocket Frog | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Pocket Frog
US crochet terms used throughout. Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
Body:
Rnd 1: Work 6 sc into a magic ring. (6)
Rnd 2: 2 sc in each st around. (12)
Rnd 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times. (18)
Rnd 4: Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 5 times, sc in next st. (24)
Rnds 5-7: Sc in each st around.
Rnd 8: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 7 times. (18)
Rnd 9: Sc in next st, sc2tog around. (12)
FO, leave a tail.
Arms (make 2):
Rnd 1: Work 6 sc into a magic ring. (6)
Rnd 2: 2 sc in each st around. (12)
Rnds 3-4: Sc in each st around. (12)
FO and sew to the head.

Row 10: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 11
Row 11: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, sc in each st until 1 st remains, 2 sc in last st. 13

text:
Striped Bean
All terms are in US crochet terminology.
This project is worked in continuous spiral rounds; place a stitch marker in the first stitch of each round and move it up as you go.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, a 3.5 mm hook, and scissors.
Rnd 1: Work 8 sc into a magic ring. (8)
Rnd 2: [2 sc in next st] 8 times. (16)
Rnd 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] around. (24)
Rnd 4: Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 7 times, sc in next st. (32)
Rnd 5: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] around. (40)
Rnd 6: Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 7 times, sc in next 2 sts. (48)
Rnd 7: [Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st] around. (56)
Rnds 8-11: Sc around.
Rnd 12: Sc around. (56)
Place safety eyes between Rnd 8 and 9, about 8 sts apart.
Rnd 13: [Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 8 times. (48)
Rnd 14: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 8 times. (40)
Rnd 15: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 8 times. (32)
Rnd 16: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 8 times. (24)
Rnd 17: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 8 times. (16)
Rnd 18: [Sc2tog] 8 times. (11)
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

header: Title: Little Pebble | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Little Pebble
Written in US terms. Worked in continuous spiral rounds.
Round 1: Work 6 sc into a magic ring. (6)
Round 2: [2 sc in next st] 6 times. (12)
Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] around. (18)
Round 4: Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 5 times, sc in next 2 sts. (24)
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times. (30)
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times. (36)
Rounds 7-8: Sc in each st around. (36)
Round 9: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 6 times. (30)
Begin stuffing.
Round 10: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times. (24)
Round 11: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] around. (18)
Round 12: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 7 times. (12)
Round 13: [Sc2tog] 6 times. (6)
Fasten off and weave in ends.

Round 10: Sc in each st around. (15)
Round 11: Sc in each st around. (15)
